artifact: P2 preregistration ADDENDUM 2 — dated correction to the A2 exhaustion/truncation boundary (operator P2 launch review: REQUEST CHANGES); all historical artifacts preserved byte-for-byte

amends.note: Additive and dated. No prior artifact was regenerated, rewritten, or re-preregistered. No qualification was rerun; the implementation is unchanged (stratum 9f298f219db927d5065876cf99cdec11e462aa04). No live P2 workflow has started, so this correction precedes the first live opportunity.

operator_ruling: Protecting the denominator is essential: the experiment must be allowed to fail because the model runs out of tokens. A model exhausting its fixed output budget during a BUILD repair is an observed failure of that workflow, not an infrastructure abort. P1-R opportunity 2 experienced a truncated repair at 32,768 tokens and WAS included in P1-R's 1/3 publication result; excluding the same failure class in P2 would break comparability and introduce outcome-dependent censoring.

A2_correction_truncated_repairs.supersedes: the addendum-1 boundary case 'token-truncated repairs are budget-censored (consume neither slot nor opportunity)' is RETRACTED. The addendum-1 record itself remains in the frozen history, unchanged; this addendum defines the effective rule.
A2_correction_truncated_repairs.effective_rule: a BUILD repair (or initial BUILD submission) truncated by the FROZEN model output budget — finish='length' / max_tokens exhaustion at the configured per-step budget (32768 for BUILD) — is an EVALUABLE FAILURE: it counts toward the workflow slot AND as a failure of that BUILD opportunity in the endpoint denominator, exactly consistent with the P1-R treatment of opportunity 2.
A2_correction_truncated_repairs.rationale: the experiment measures whether the frozen model, using the frozen budget and protocol, publishes a BUILD proposal. Output-budget exhaustion is model-attributable under the frozen regime; censoring it would be outcome-dependent.

effective_disposition_table.infrastructure_failure_before_any_model_: non-evaluable abort (P1-R precedent 5f79a128); consumes neither slot nor opportunity
effective_disposition_table.pre_build_step_failure_including_its_max: consumes the workflow slot; produces NO BUILD opportunity; slot re-queued (P1-R precedent ef573d80/32b96f25; unchanged from the original preregistration's aborted_run definition and the design the operator approved in principle)
effective_disposition_table.bounded_repair_exhausts_its_token_budget: EVALUABLE FAILURE (this addendum's correction; P1-R op2-consistent)
effective_disposition_table.model_fabricates_an_unknown_anchor: evaluable failure (mechanic D keeps it a genuine error; addendum-1 boundary case stands)
effective_disposition_table.stratum_rejects_a_valid_authoritative_pa: S7 STOP (objective offline-replay rules of addendum 1, unchanged)
effective_disposition_table.evidence_integrity_fails: STOP (rule S2 of the original preregistration, unchanged)

post_model_infrastructure_malfunction_na.note: the only censoring class that may occur AFTER model calls begin; deliberately narrow, and any ambiguity resolves to EVALUABLE (fail-closed toward the denominator) so censoring can never be outcome-dependent
all_conditions_required: the archived loop log shows a transport/provider error class verbatim (HTTP 5xx, connection reset/timeout, process kill) for the affected turn — never a completed model message
the archived turn carries NO budget signal (no finish='length', no max_tokens stop reason) and NO model-attributable content (no partial proposal text entering the archive)
the failure is recorded as an infra-censoring event in the run archive with the provider error evidence attached
post_model_infrastructure_malfunction_na.if_any_condition_fails_or_is_ambiguous: the event is EVALUABLE — it counts toward the slot and the BUILD opportunity denominator under the endpoint taxonomy
post_model_infrastructure_malfunction_na.scope_limit: a censored BUILD turn is censored, not the whole opportunity, unless the malfunction prevents any recordable BUILD outcome; in that case the opportunity is censored with the same evidence bar and the event is journaled for operator inspection

comparability_note: with this correction, the BUILD-opportunity denominator in P2 is defined identically to P1-R's: every run that reaches the BUILD loop yields an evaluable opportunity whose outcome includes output-budget exhaustion, malformed/unauthorized proposals, fabricated anchors, and fail-closed staging rejections. P1-R (1/3) remains context, not a statistical comparator.
